title: Introduction to Signal Processing, Second Edition
where: Rutgers ECE's official Sophocles J. Orfanidis page at https://ece.rutgers.edu/orfanidis links the complete second edition and states that Orfanidis acquired the necessary licenses and made his books freely available. The linked legal full PDF is hosted by Rutgers Box at https://rutgers.app.box.com/s/92is8ajwe2b0liokflkqx1ul2fqqqa7l (direct PDF endpoint: https://rutgers.app.box.com/shared/static/92is8ajwe2b0liokflkqx1ul2fqqqa7l.pdf).

shards.note: Foundations through spectral analysis: sampling, quantization, discrete-time systems, convolution, z-transforms, transfer functions, direct/canonical/lattice realizations, DTFT, windowing, and periodograms. The range ends immediately before Chapter 10.

Core algorithms and designs: DFT/FFT and fast convolution, FIR, IIR and elliptic filter design, interpolation/decimation/oversampling, and noise reduction. The range ends immediately before Part II and Chapter 16.

First application block: audio effects, parametric equalizers, STFT/phase vocoder, DCT/MDCT compression, wavelets, continuous-to-discrete methods, control systems, and local polynomial filters. The range ends immediately before Chapter 24.

shards.range: Chapters 24–29, References, and Index (book pages 1160–1505; remaining PDF back matter through physical page 1540)
shards.note: Second application and reference block: exponential moving averages, financial-market filtering, Whittaker-Henderson smoothing, periodic extraction, neural networks, appendices, bibliography, and index.

notes: The official 2023 second-edition PDF is complete, unencrypted, and 1540 physical PDF pages. Its front matter identifies Sophocles J. Orfanidis, Rutgers University, second-edition copyright 2023, and the official Rutgers book URL. The verified detailed contents contain 29 numbered chapters: Part I covers Chapters 1–15 and Part II covers Chapters 16–29. Four shards were chosen because the source exceeds both size thresholds (350 pages and 25 chapters); ranges are balanced at approximately 409, 357, 393, and 381 pages and every boundary falls between chapters.
